# iosxe_voice_class_sip_profiles (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class SIP Profiles configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_sip_profiles" "example" {
  tag = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip profiles tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of a sip-profile
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Specify the rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
